scope: Six PISCO animal histories; all years
finding: 38 unsupported species/zone/comparison uses represent 24 distinct site-date combinations (29 site-zone-dates; 34 species-site-dates), not 38 independent visits. 26 post uses block 19 comparison-years; remaining 12 uses affect seven non-post comparison-years.
recommended_action: Use explicit count units and link uses to blocked comparison-years.

finding: Independent completeness reconstruction confirms 44/63 biomass comparison-years and exactly the saved supported flags; no unsupported reference station is silently omitted.
recommended_action: Retain 44/63 as current strict-review coverage, with diagnostic exceptions separate.

finding: 20 uses lack both eligible local-year sizes and eligible same-role other-site donors; 17 have candidate data but fail calibration-group guards; one fails date-gap guards. All 38 positive densities reproduce from raw counts; none has eligible same-visit sizes in either size inventory or swath.
recommended_action: Separate missing source data from computational guards; do not describe all 38 as missing measurements.

finding: Four local animals sized 2019-10-25 give gap294 vs empirical max290. Diagnostic allowance restores Abalone red2019:7/11 to8/11 and total44/63 to45/63. Only two calibration site-years/four reciprocal rows exist, both MID2015.
recommended_action: Recommend a small explicit rounding/tolerance sensitivity consistent with user instruction that a few days should not exclude; retain sparse temporal-calibration warning. Do not claim validation or adopt a threshold here.

finding: 15 protected uses have same-role cross-site donors but zero nested outer-site calibration groups; two protected stations leave only one after holding target out, so cross-site calibration is structurally unavailable. Six such uses are post, and only five post years are blocked solely by this guard; purple2016 also has data gaps.
recommended_action: Retain donor availability independently of calibration eligibility. Prefer original missing local samples; any alternative uncertainty model requires explicit review, not removal of the guard by counting rows as replication.

finding: Besides Point Fermin, LONG_POINT_E red MID and purple INNER2010 have one-day local matches; ROCKY_POINT_N red/purple INNER2009 have two-day local matches. All four fail temporal calibration (zero groups), and all are non-post.
recommended_action: Flag these short-date matches for campaign metadata review; they restore no post years in the 63-year denominator. Do not call them same-visit measurements without evidence.

scope: Unsupported ledger reasons and consolidated guide
finding: Final reason overwrites same-site attempt with cross-site failure. ROCKY_POINT_N red/purple2009 are labeled no donors despite local samples two days later. Unsupported rows also lose available donors and calibration diagnostics.
recommended_action: Preserve per-attempt reason, candidate dates/animals/sites, target gap, calibration maximum and group count; derive combined reason and post-year impact. Update generator before regenerating guide.

finding: All682 inventory sample-use rows reconstructed from combined raw sizes and fixed retained mapping; keys and weighted means match. No alternate site_new rescue found for38 gaps. LONG_POINT_E purple MID2022 contains only sub25mm local sizes, ineligible for adult counts.
recommended_action: No join repair or cutoff relaxation justified; retain frequency multiplicity and adult cutoff. Scope is delivered local holdings, not unavailable original field records.
